description: This PHP class 'DetailsToExpand' processes HTML content, converting specific 'details' macro elements into expandable sections, handling CDATA sections, namespace tags, and avoiding code blocks.

classes.name: DetailsToExpand
classes.description: A class that converts Confluence 'details' macros into expandable sections in HTML, handling namespace tags, CDATA, and code blocks.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Main method that processes input HTML content, converting 'details' macros into expandable sections.

methods.name: findSummary
methods.description: Finds a 'summary' child element within a DOM element.

methods.name: isWithinCodeBlock
methods.description: Checks if a DOM element is inside a code block macro.

methods.name: convertOne
methods.description: Converts a single 'details' macro element into an expandable macro if applicable.
